findings: [P2] Malformed Beads status values bypass classified error handling. In BeadsAdapter._json(), item.get("status") in {"ERROR", "INVALID"} raises TypeError when valid JSON contains a list or object status, such as {"status":[]}. This happens before Issue.model_validate(), and cli.main() does not catch TypeError, so malformed source data produces an uncaught traceback instead of SCHEMA_MISMATCH or another stable adapter error. Check that status is a string before set membership, and add regression coverage for list/object status values.
